## Why not the other candidates

I checked the plausible plan-omitted readings before committing to this one:

- **Semicolon/quote integrity in the `File` section** — already safe: rows go through `csv.writer(delimiter=";")`, so a customer like `Zed; Inc` emits `"Zed; Inc"` and still parses as exactly 7 columns. Hand-rolled `";".join(...)` would break here; mine doesn't.
- **`TEST-` exclusion** — already implemented and tested, before this change.
- **Half-even VAT, rates, summary format, stderr `skipped`** — all implemented, and a byte-level diff against a reference written straight from the spec text was identical.

One deliberate non-change: `net` is still quantized to cents before the VAT multiply, so `net + vat == gross` holds on the printed row. Computing VAT from an unrounded net would diverge from that invariant for hypothetical >2-decimal nets; the spec fixes the amounts at 2 decimals.
